title: Supply the complete declared source-backing entry grant for the first-range Node caller
body:
The complete PR5135 Consumer backing reserve still assumed an arbitrary caller-entry K0. This package supplies that whole local premise for the unchanged PR2697 first-range Node/Driver: K0 ≤ K_external + G, where G is computed entirely from declared entry geometry, nine named input backing lengths and fixed arena capacities. It covers MOVE, COPY and idle entry plus split, gathering, routing, merging, return and retained erased backing.

The quantified result is conditional on the stated canonical positive domain, successful execution and original source callbacks. The metric is distinct Tape.cells/Word.cells array lengths, not Python heap or physical tape movement. External suspended parents remain explicitly external. PR2753 recursive interiors use different Consumer source and are excluded; this does not improve an asymptotic admission or selected multiplication bound.

Validation authenticates all 50 original source files, the 45-entry count snapshot and 20 PR5135 runtime modules. Three actual reduced caller entry censuses use an independent source-frame ownership graph; deleting a still-owned cleared Tape from the weak observer rejects. The COPY case completes its preceding original model MOVE. A separate exchange-only complete Node checks output order and borrowed bytes/heads. These finite checks do not run the full selected word or GL64.

Normal and optimized checks pass on CPython 3.12.7/macOS arm64. Exact-head source-history and official export checks pass for 71 package/input files. Fresh Git-free, empty-PATH normal and optimized runs pass; source corruption, missing source, missing RESULT/SOURCES, bool-to-int receipt mutation and nested int-to-float receipt mutation all reject. Receipt comparison uses canonical JSON over the entire result. No historical suite was replayed. Independent agent source/proof review found no blocker within the stated scope; no formal-kernel or native Windows/Linux validation is claimed.

Final head: `0daf29f28f0885cf7359a0e92a37efbbcc388136`.
Export SHA256: `3453b738b2fb69909ac5ed5870d044024f034d3d633399106f40dfede7fa1b5d`.

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Original contributor attribution and Apache-2.0 notices are retained.
